logo.svg.source: supplied in the Kadri Coffee demo brand asset kit: logos/kadri-symbol-dark.svg (the README's compact mark; dark, for a light background), bytes unchanged

logo-reversed.svg.source: supplied in the kit: logos/kadri-symbol-light.svg (cream, for a dark background), bytes unchanged; rendered on the ink scheme (tokens.css --brand-logo-variant: reversed)

kadri-wordmark-dark.svg.source: supplied in the kit: logos/kadri-wordmark-dark.svg, bytes unchanged; kept, not used on posts (below the kit's 100px minimum width at the logo slot's size)

kadri-wordmark-light.svg.source: supplied in the kit: logos/kadri-wordmark-light.svg, bytes unchanged; kept, not used on posts

fonts.sourceNote: families, roles and weights from the kit's brand guide typography table; files from the kit's fonts/ (sha256 MonaSansVF.ttf 84aae10d4427a1947e96b1fd9b26c3109ffa0f50f2faae8ce460ca1e34889ed5, HubotSansVF-Regular.ttf 9887a667164b597693b3200fe8573e8505cf33296b8a6e3a2da4fcaba50a0492), SIL OFL 1.1; tracking stays derived

--brand-paper.source: supplied: brand-tokens.json colors.cream "#FFF5DF"; the guide: cream is used for large branding and label backgrounds

--brand-accent.source: supplied: brand-tokens.json colors.coral "#FF603E" (the guide: colour-logo coral)

--brand-accent-ink.source: the ink on the coral surface, 5.04:1 (WCAG, measured at intake); the guide puts ink lettering on the coloured badges, but does not name text on coral

--brand-muted.source: the kit has three shared colours and no muted one; the ink stands in. Only the hairline rule and the slide foot read it; no proposal uses them

--brand-font-display.source: supplied: the guide's typography table, "Product names, headings, small labels: Mona Sans, 500"

--brand-font-body.source: supplied: the guide's typography table, "Tasting notes and supporting text: Mona Sans, 400"

--brand-weight-body.source: supplied: the guide, supporting text wght=400

--brand-weight-label.source: supplied: the guide, small labels wght=500

--brand-tracking-display.source: the guide sets tracking for the wordmark only (-9 at 390px, -0.023em); headings keep the face's own spacing

--brand-tracking-label.source: uppercase labels opened to 0.06em; the guide says nothing about label tracking

--brand-radius.source: read from the kit's label artwork: rx="28" on the 1000x600 cream label (components/*-label.svg)

--brand-logo-variant.source: the dark k vanishes on the ink surface, so the ink scheme renders the cream k; the kit's own rule is dark mark on light, cream mark on dark, but it does not name a post scheme
